name: Scene Parameter Saliency via Differentiable Light Transport
aliases: per-parameter gradients of a scalar objective
definition: A method to compute the sensitivity of a scalar image-space metric M to scene parameters θ by calculating the gradient g = ∂M/∂θ using automatic differentiation (backpropagation) through the differentiable renderer.
summary: Scene Parameter Saliency via Differentiable Light Transport identifies influential scene parameters by backpropagating through physical light transport, capturing multi-bounce dependencies that neural methods miss.
